description_en: Queries the default parameter templates for MongoDB instances
description_zh: 查询MongoDB实例默认的参数模板列表
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-parameter-templates --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine mongodb --engine-version 5.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeParameterTemplates

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The database engine. Set the value to mongodb
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The database version number. Valid values:

7.0

6.0

5.0

4.4

4.2

4.0

3.4
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The role of the instance. Valid values:

db: the shard role of a sharded cluster instance.

cs: the config server role of a sharded cluster instance.

mongos: the mongos role of a sharded cluster instance.

normal: the role of a replica set instance.

physical: the role of a single node instance.

The default value is normal
parameters.help_zh:
实例的角色类型，取值说明：

db：分片集群shard角色。
cs：分片集群config server角色。
mongos：分片集群mongos角色。
normal: 副本集角色。
physical：单节点角色。

默认值为normal
parameters.name: role

CheckingCode.description_en: The valid values of the parameter

ForceModify.description_en:
Indicates whether the parameter can be modified.

false: The parameter cannot be modified.

true: The parameter can be modified
ForceModify.description_zh:
参数是否处于可修改的状态。
false：不可修改。
true：可修改。

ForceRestart.description_en:
Indicates whether a restart is required for the parameter modification to take effect.

false: A restart is not required. The modification takes effect after you submit the modification.

true: A restart is required for the modification to take effect
ForceRestart.description_zh:
修改参数后是否需要重启生效。
false：无需重启，提交后即生效。
true：需要重启生效
